bars.says: Colonists enter green canopy above low standing steam, with firm root routes through slow churnmud and foliage that obstructs pawn sight while close inspection still identifies the footing.

meant.intent: Ordinary land is a steaming, obstructed but readable place in which route choice matters.
meant.source: the_greentide.md sections 1, 4c, 8b; composition root; delegated from these pictures, subject to later Direct Sun and fixed-world rulings

accept: Low steam obscures ground detail while tree crowns and silhouettes remain readable; inspecting a cell identifies mud or root footing, and a colonist takes the root route around boggy undergrowth.
A shot or witnessed act is blocked by the mature sight-blocking understory; the player can still inspect the map and an open lane restores pawn sight.
reject: A green recolour of an open swamp, or a screen-wide grey fog that erases crowns and ground equally, leaves no distinct low-steam jungle.
Root texture is painted over mud but has the same footing, or a visible thicket allows pawn sight straight through it.
bars.lazy: none: Low steam versus readable crowns, real footing contrast and pawn sight obstruction all occur in the sentence; recoloured clear terrain or flat opaque fog cannot satisfy it.

range.varies: Full local maps 150x150, 250x250, 325x325; flat, large-hill and mountain relief; river, river edge and authored riverless-remnant contexts; leaf stages before/at/after sight threshold; approach bearings 0..359 degrees; camera normal/close; Roil, clearing and return; colony 1..40.
range.left_out: Planet generation and painting are excluded. A riverless remnant is not automatically a wet living-river example; no invented water or rosters. Artistic variants need the same legibility, not a fixed count.

figurative.stands_for: from dangerous living surroundings into useful colony stock and work, not compulsory departure from the biome

accept: A forager finds edible fruit and roots, a fisher returns an exotic catch, a hunter brings meat and a herder keeps a grazer; fallen timber and resin are useful at home, while a cracking tree, concealed water hunt and disturbed gall each force a legible decision.

A gall found naturally beside its living host releases defending wasps when disturbed; retreat ends pursuit without erasing the insects, and a concealed hunt hushes biome ambience with a visible warning before the player can respond.
reject: Every pictured plant is decoration, useful catches require a debug spawn, or all danger exists in descriptions while harvesting is carefree.
Every route is permanently lethal even to a prepared party, warnings arrive only after unavoidable loss, or a threat vanishes silently when the party retreats.
A flying native walks throughout its ordinary travel, or the hum of machinery is muted instead of the biome hunt warning.
bars.lazy: none: Actual useful return, natural plant/predator/insect danger, readable signs and retreat are jointly required; a decorative zoo or debug-only harvest cannot satisfy those words.

bars.says: A colony living through the complete Greentide cycle can earn and maintain a productive foothold, recover from neglect and continue after saving and returning, while the jungle remains threatening without overrunning the map, becoming barren, trapping routine work or filling the log with errors.

meant.intent: The first version running whole: abundance, pressure, defence, retrieval and recovery coexist rather than passing in isolated scenes.
meant.source: Owner cleanse brief whole-bar requirement 2026-11-16; owner inhabited-home/recovery/rescue answers 2026-11-10; binding danger/reward and flat-danger choice in GREENTIDE_RISK_REWARD_EXCHANGE_1

figurative.stands_for: a productive inhabited home with maintained working access, not a literal foot-sized hold
figurative.accept: An enclosed workshop and kitchen with maintained firm approaches is a productive home even though nobody stands on a special ledge.

accept: During ordinary work the colony gathers, cooks, fishes, builds, studies, treats illness and maintains exposed access; a defence interruption produces a visible problem, people and property are recovered, and upkeep restores productive work while living jungle persists outside.

After a mid-cycle reload the same threats, belongings, suppression expiry and work remain intelligible; doing harvest before upkeep or upkeep before harvest both permit a maintained foothold, and a clearing returns naturally to steam.
reject: A lush opening scene turns into unchecked vegetation or insect takeover, a stripped barren map, perpetual rescue/dig loops or repeated exceptions once growth, weather, predators and work run together.
The demonstration locks the sky clear, removes predators, forces every job or top event, leaves research locked, omits a mid-cycle reload, or depends on a deferred tool or landmark.
Everything resumes after load only because threats or buried belongings were reset, or the colony stays safe only while the script replenishes supplies.
bars.lazy: none: The complete cycle, maintained/recoverable home, continued save return and explicit flood/barren/stall/error exclusions rule out a staged safe afternoon or reload that erases the threats.

range.varies: Full maps 150/250/325 per side, each relief/water context from B1; a season of 15 game days per arm, extended beyond that until the required natural growth and Roil/clearing/return cycle has completed; an uneventful short run cannot be called a whole-cycle reading; small/new, working 8-colonist and 40-colonist colonies; maintained/outage/repaired/prolonged-neglect policies; no repeated population/difficulty inflation. Save after day 7 during active suppression/burial/illness where feasible, reload and finish. Repeat from same baseline in the second action order. Rare conditional behavior gets B2/B6/B7 transition arms in addition to, never instead of, the default-season run. Main-action schedules preserve real prerequisites: stabilize/clear then gather/process/study/care/retrieve versus gather/retrieve/care then stabilize/clear/study/process; all main actions occur in both, without manufactured success or waived failures.
range.left_out: Worldgen, alternative worlds, deferred extras and absent-DLC configurations. Riverless remnants without enough water cannot stand in for an inhabited wet-river positive case. Engine tick acceleration is allowed; skipping growth, weather, hunger, job, illness, spawn or expiry ticks is not. No claim of enjoyment as a pass condition.

sees.instrument: Live full-season ordinary-play audit with timestamped state/work/economy/log trace and M2 calibrated whole-mod simulation. T34/T40 supply the replay and comparative orders. Compressed wall time must preserve game tick ordering and all named cycles.
sees.start: Fresh local map in the fixed-world context, or specified authored remnant negative arm; normal non-dev-supplied colony resources, enough preparatory unlocked technology to exercise the kept actions, loaded-content/settings fingerprints and initial ecosystem/property/work ledger; neither weather nor growth locked.
sees.on: All kept Greentide mechanics and their shared-engine gates at shipped defaults, all research/work prerequisites available, all DLC installed; next-version extras off. Natural weather clock unlocked. A paired mechanism-off control is supplemental, never the accepted run. Capture actual loaded content/settings fingerprints.
sees.control: Paired maintained/neglected zones and policy replays on the same saved local geometry isolate management from lucky terrain. Source-tagged births, damage, food and work account for outcomes; inspect all kept master gates and rates at start/mid/end so a disabled mechanism cannot explain apparent balance. Record interruptions rather than cleaning them away.
sees.reset: Disposable baseline save plus settings/derived-def snapshot: reload baseline and restore prior values after each arm. Record loaded fingerprints and verify subjects, property, queues, weather and registrations match baseline. Never restore guessed defaults over prior user settings.
sees.live_only_why: Rendering/audio and the meaning of the running player scene cannot be inferred from defs or kernel outputs; model/state readings supply corroboration, not this judgment.

tests.reject: Required by Owner cleanse brief whole-bar requirement 2026-11-16; owner inhabited-home/recovery/rescue answers 2026-11-10; binding danger/reward and flat-danger choice in GREENTIDE_RISK_REWARD_EXCHANGE_1; a false outcome removes The first version running whole: abundance, pressure, defence, retrieval and recovery coexist rather than passing in isolated scenes.
tests.renormalize: No yield/stat/size/variant quota in the experience or pictures; retuning checks does not rewrite or re-pass this bar.
tests.first_version: Land, life, signature or explicit needed_by arguments in census.json; no deferred capability is assumed.

checks.what: Parse actual BiomeDef wildAnimals/wildPlants as element-name records, including available patch payloads; do not count li. Record current weights, density and forage values and a same-purpose vanilla swamp baseline as context, not bars.

Current literal baseline: plantDensity 0.99, movementDifficulty 4, animalDensity 3.2 in RM_Greentide_Biome.xml. movementDifficulty is world travel, not local footing. Sentinel-change/readback plus restore must discriminate a dead density applier.

Resolve all local defs/recipes/aliases/compile includes and assets against the actual load composition; current source hashes do not prove deployed hashes. Historical campaign paths are absent, so patched cast and cross-biome dependencies remain unmeasured.
Keep production-kernel C# fuzz (swallow/mire/ladder/vurrak/rules) as regression readings, including deferred mechanisms. Static parsing, mocked plans and Python mirrors never accept gameplay.

Read individual settings flips and effect scopes, derive effective gates through shared kits, persist/reload/reset and verify cleanup on existing effects. Distinct sentinel values, not equality at shipped defaults. Log clean/load/settings are the inherited floor, never extra bars.

Freeze a census of native low-flammability flora including own grass/tall grass; verify inherited flammability and burn spread under shared rules. A gall can burn as a papery insect structure without redefining green native foliage as fuel.

Verify complete object fingerprints and quantity conservation across Scribe, partial stack merge, full map, cancellation, death, settings off and disposal. This catches the current def/stuff/count-only reconstruction risk.
Read field membership per blower rotation, suppression source/expiry, actual grazing writes, weather condition priority, native/airborne immunity and environmental-water eligibility.
Trace completed job source and destination for automatic rescue/dig, doses and lace; preserve initial disease/mark/study counters and confirm Frenzy replacement of flu and malaria.
State-read flight tracker for all kept fictional flyers and verify directional whole-body animation paths. Visual flight sessions require the owner; no screenshot claim.

Default-off extra tests read both absent activation and present enabled activation, including indirect incident, damage-trigger, recipe, job, letter and startup-patch routes. Alias resolution and other-biome shared services remain present.

Season trace records hourly eligible cells/plants, edible produce, timber, grazing intake, suppression, wildlife births/deaths/hunts/stings, route cost/reachability, job backlog, warning-to-loss times, buried property and unique log signatures; export settings/content fingerprints alongside it.

rules.rule: Only local maps on the existing fixed world are in scope; map-local terrain placement is not planet generation. No alternative planet scoring, new worldgen, repaint or tile-count finding. Root causeways stay static and use the existing fallback-anchor path when living landmarks are off.

Ordinary wet-native regrowth respects floors, edifices and enclosed rooms under ExplosiveGrowth. Define doorway pressure on exposed eligible approach cells; do not break that law or substitute debug bursts. Normal light-gated maturation replaces old dark-roots wording.

Newly cleared approaches require maintenance under natural cycles. Initial candidate check envelope: untreated exposed routes show renewed impediment over 1..3 game days; recovery after a 6-hour defence outage is possible. These are Designer tuning hypotheses, not owner numbers or bars; M2 may change them while preserving recovery-first.

Blower protection uses the existing forward arc and suppression expiry; active requires all installed power/fuel/flick prerequisites. It prevents new growth rather than deleting existing thickets. Room cooling is behind it, never deliberate exhaust heating. Grazing writes only on actual ingestion.

Vulnerable grounded travellers mire; Greentide natives and airborne pawns do not. Freeing must yield a reachable nearby firm destination for both subjects and must fail readably when no such destination exists. No new custom job if extending the existing one suffices.

Burial transfers full object state to a saved holder, never reconstructs only def/stuff/count. Stockpiles have no exemption. Corpse, minified and held objects remain visibly excluded; frozen buried time, retained unplaceable remainder and recoverable designations prevent loss/duplication. Turning off new burial never locks old contents away.

Common Direct Sun is geometric with shared tree/roof shade; ambient heat is vanilla air temperature. The legacy per-biome felt-offset extension/prose is not an authorized heat mechanism. Roil/Breaklight change the visible weather and shared AI response, never a local sun value.

Roil is ordinary weather, Breaklight temporarily wins and then returns. No permanent proof-scene lock. Keep the explicitly first-playable shade response and predator hush; hush applies to biome ambience, not machinery, with overlapping reasons owned by the existing shared silence service.

Keep every current roster placement; record multi-homing without eviction. Off-by-default abilities leave ordinary species and old save instances intact. A fictional flyer uses actual flight and directional whole-body animation; proof is flight state, no unattended visual flight test. Natives can use their environmental water.

Keep Frenzy ambient and portable-dose routes, work/collapse/treatment-death fork, earned collapse-survivor resistance; masters govern existing marks as well as new awards. Keep only the selected stellock discovery/bleed-stop medicine chain, using shared study and vanilla care; lace is not treatment.

Shared settings name the actual owner of each gate. Defaults enable retained mechanics and disable next-version extras. Label Now/new-map/next-start; snapshot prior settings plus derived defs for checks. All-off stops new harm and releases existing traps/protection cleanly without deleting pawns, inventory, or recoverable buried contents.

Do not compensate for experience or population with growing biome danger. Ordinary management uses vanilla work priorities; no forty-pawn manual-order requirement, periodic inventory grants or secret threat cleanup. Bounded shared response budgets remain intact.

Natural host-associated galls are adjacent standalone Things using existing reaction events. On host removal stop future hosting, preserve visible gall/wasp lifecycle and shared population limits. No automatic whole-map replacement loop.

meetings.why: Footing, growth, fallen trunks and rescues can jointly cut the only usable route even if each works alone. Keep a firm rescue route and test full geometry, not pairwise claims.

Wet sprouts feed grazers, grazing suppresses sprouts, falls change canopy/light, fruit passage adds seedlings, and defence changes hauling capacity. Population and coverage can oscillate or collapse in combination.
meetings.model: M2 Season of an inhabited foothold

meetings.why: The rules exclude a private heat species, but canopy loss plus clearing, room cooling and work timing may still make practical recovery impossible. Actual geometric shading and weather order need calibration.
Native feeding, water, immunity, canopy gnawing, tree turnover, predator warning and bounded gall responses must support a continuing population and practical retreat with forty colonists.

meetings.why: Burial, seed-food traffic, dose/lace inventory and reload/cancellation can lose identity or duplicate a partial merge. The present cache stores insufficient state.
Hauling, maintenance, rescue, digging and medicine draw on the same workers; dose-induced collapse or a blocked approach can create a three-way rescue/food/health stall.

meetings.why: Startup patches, map conditions, derived defs and live gates have different lifetimes. All-off and mid-cycle reload must not leave stuck pawns, active deferred triggers or lost belongings.
